name: categorize_transactions
description: Proposes giving one category to one or more transactions, and optionally a payee. Use it when the user asks to categorize, classify or recategorize transactions, including every uncategorized transaction found by search_transactions. Do not use it to split a transaction among categories: change_transaction does. The user confirms before categories change.

transaction_ids.description: IDs of the transactions, from search_transactions; at most 50

category_id.description: income or expense category from list_accounts

payee_id.description: payee to set on each transaction, from list_payees_and_tags

status.description: categorized, not_found, version_conflict, transaction_voided or not_categorizable

name: change_transaction
description: Proposes a change to an existing transaction: correct its date, description, payee, tags, amount or accounts; turn its category side into a transfer to another own account; or make this incoming transaction the reimbursement of recorded expenses. Use it when the user asks to fix, edit or relink a transaction. Do not use it to set a category: categorize_transactions does; nor to void: void_transaction does; nor for card refunds: handle_card_purchase does. The user confirms before the change applies.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction, from search_transactions

action.description: correct changes the fields given; make_transfer replaces the category side with another own account; reimburse links this incoming transaction to the expenses it repays

reason.description: for correct: why the transaction changes, kept in its history

payee_id.description: for correct: new payee from list_payees_and_tags

tags.description: for correct: the complete new list of tags

amount.description: for correct: new positive amount of a transaction with one source and one destination

from_account_id.description: for correct: new source account or category

to_account_id.description: for correct: new destination account or category; for make_transfer: the own account that receives the money

amount.description: positive decimal amount allocated to it

allocations.description: for reimburse: the expenses repaid and the part of this transaction each takes

name: get_account_details
description: Returns one account in depth: reconciliation state and recorded institution balances; for a credit card account, its plastic cards, current credit limit and available limit, billing cycle, statements, the statement a purchase date falls on and the installments already committed to a month. Use it for questions about one account or card. Do not use it for a statement's lines: get_statement returns them.

account_id.description: ID of the account, from list_accounts

purchase_date.description: for a card: return the statement a purchase on this date is billed on

month.description: for a card: return the installments committed to the statement of this month; written YYYY-MM

statements_from.description: for a card: first statement month to list; the last 6 months when absent; written YYYY-MM

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

name: get_account_history
description: Returns the daily balance of an account and its sub-accounts over a period, or its booked inflow and outflow per day. Use it for how a balance evolved or how much entered and left an account. Do not use it for a balance at one date: get_balances does; nor for the future: project_balance does.

view.description: balances gives the balance each day; flows gives inflow and outflow each day with postings

to.description: last date, inclusive; at most 366 days after from

currency.description: currency or instrument code of the account

granularity.description: day lists every day; week, for periods over 92 days, lists each Sunday and the last day

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

name: get_balances
description: Returns the balance of every asset, liability and equity account at a date, by class and then account name; accounts with a zero balance are omitted. Use it for how much is in accounts, cards owed or net position at a date. Do not use it for spending by category: get_category_totals returns it; nor for a balance over time: get_account_history returns it.

date.description: balances at the end of this date; today when absent

basis.description: booked places a posting at the transaction date, settled at the institution's settlement date; booked when absent

class.description: keep only accounts of this class

limit.description: items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; absent for the first page

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

next_cursor.description: present when more balances follow; pass it as cursor

name: get_category_totals
description: Totals the income or expense categories in a period, each with its own total and the total of its subtree, in category name order; only categories with postings and their ancestors are listed. Use it for how much was spent or earned by category. Do not use it for the transactions behind a total: search_transactions with account_id lists them.

class.description: expense totals spending, income totals earnings; both are positive

to.description: last date, inclusive; at most 366 days after from

limit.description: items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; absent for the first page

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

subtree_total.description: postings on the category and its descendants

next_cursor.description: present when more categories follow; pass it as cursor

name: get_help
description: Returns an article of the equori guide: what a concept means in this app, how a task is done, and the screens where it is done with their paths. Use it for how-to and where-is questions, for concepts such as postings, statements or reconciliation, and for tasks the assistant cannot do, such as adding bank credentials or importing a file. Do not use it for the user's own data: the other tools return it.

path.description: route of the screen; a $name segment stands for an ID

screens.description: screens of the topic; empty when the topic has none

name: get_imports
description: Returns import activity: statement import batches with their counts, the records of a batch and those needing review, entries of an account that no bank line confirmed, and bank connections with their sync state and accounts. Use it for whether a bank synced, what an import did or what needs review. Do not use it for the transactions themselves: search_transactions does.

batch_id.description: for records: batch from the batches view

state.description: for records: keep records in this state

account_id.description: for unconfirmed: balance account from list_accounts

limit.description: items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; absent for the first page

source.description: file format, or the aggregator for a sync

counts.description: lines by outcome; absent outcomes are zero

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

candidates.description: transactions the record may match, best first; get_transaction describes them

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

state.description: mapped, ignored or pending a decision

next_cursor.description: present when more items follow; pass it as cursor

name: get_market_data
description: Returns market data of the instance: instruments with their type and scale, one instrument with its fixed income terms, prices of an instrument in a period, business-day calendars or a calendar's holidays in a year. Use it for prices, securities and holidays. Do not use it for the user's holdings: get_portfolio does.

code.description: for instrument and prices: instrument code, such as a ticker or currency code

quote.description: for prices: code of the currency the price is quoted in

to.description: for prices: last date; at most 366 days after from

calendar.description: for holidays: calendar identifier from the calendars view

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

name: get_portfolio
description: Returns investment views at a date: positions with quantity, cost and market value; allocation by instrument type, currency or institution; net worth; or the annual return of an account over a period. Also lists the income types and instrument subtypes the user's tax jurisdiction accepts. Use it for questions about investments and net worth. Do not use it for cash balances only: get_balances does; nor for a tax year: get_tax_year does.

date.description: for positions, allocation and net_worth: valuation date; today when absent

account_id.description: for return: account or brokerage from list_accounts

description: Returns one credit card statement with its amounts, status, dates and every line: charges, credits, payments and installments. Use it to explain a statement or check its lines. Do not use it to list statements: get_account_details lists them with their IDs.

statement_id.description: ID of the statement, from get_account_details

limit.description: items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; absent for the first page

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

name: get_tax_year
description: Returns a tax year of investments: realized results of sales at average cost with their tax class, and investment income with its tax treatment. Use it to prepare a tax return or answer what was gained or received in a year. Do not use it for current positions: get_portfolio does.

view.description: sales gives realized results, income gives income events; both when absent

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

name: get_transaction
description: Returns one transaction in full: postings, links to refunds and reimbursements, earlier versions with their reasons, attachment names, disputes and, for an installment purchase, its plan. Use it before changing a transaction or to explain its history. Do not use it to find transactions: search_transactions does.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction, from search_transactions

include_reimbursement.description: also list the incoming transactions that can repay this expense, or the expenses this incoming transaction can repay

account_class.description: a posting on an income or expense account is the category of the transaction

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

statement.description: reference month of the statement, YYYY-MM

name: handle_card_purchase
description: Proposes an event on a card purchase: a full or partial refund, opening or resolving a dispute, cancelling the remaining installments, or paying installments early. Use it when the user reports a refund, a chargeback, a cancelled installment purchase or an early payment of installments. Do not use it to record a new purchase: record_transaction does. The user confirms first.

date.description: date of the event; today when absent

amount.description: for refund and anticipate_installments: positive amount in the card's currency

outcome.description: for resolve_dispute: won refunds the remaining charged amount

from_installment.description: for anticipate_installments: first installment number paid early

to_installment.description: for anticipate_installments: last installment number paid early

statement.description: statement month the credit or the anticipated installments go to; the next open statement when absent; written YYYY-MM

name: list_accounts
description: Lists the user's accounts and categories by class and then name, with the IDs the other tools take, each account's institution, and the user's base currency. Income and expense accounts are the categories of transactions; a child account carries its parent. Use it to find the ID of an account or category named by the user. Do not use it for balances: get_balances returns them.

class.description: keep only accounts of this class; income and expense accounts are the categories of transactions

limit.description: items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; absent for the first page

kind.description: kind of an asset or liability account, such as checking or credit_card

currency.description: currency or instrument code of the account

system_role.description: set on accounts the ledger creates, such as uncategorized_expense

next_cursor.description: present when more accounts follow; pass it as cursor

name: list_payees_and_tags
description: Lists the user's payees, the tags in use or the institutions, by name, with IDs. Use it to find the payee_id a write takes or to check whether a payee, tag or institution exists. Do not use it for transactions of a payee: search_transactions with query does that.

query.description: case-insensitive text the name must contain

limit.description: items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; absent for the first page

next_cursor.description: present when more items follow; pass it as cursor

name: manage_accounts_and_payees
description: Proposes a change to accounts, categories, payees or institutions: create, rename or move an account or category, close or reopen it, merge a category or payee into another, create or rename a payee, create an institution. Use it when the user asks to organize accounts, categories or payees. Do not use it for card settings: manage_card does. Merging cannot be undone; the user confirms every change.

account_id.description: account or category to change or merge, from list_accounts

name.description: name of the new or renamed account, category, payee or institution

class.description: for create_account: class of the new account; income and expense create categories

kind.description: for create_account of an asset or liability: kind of account

currency.description: for create_account: currency or instrument code; the base currency when absent

parent_id.description: for create_account and update_account: parent account or category

institution_id.description: for create_account and update_account: institution from list_payees_and_tags

date.description: for close_account: closing date; today when absent

into_id.description: for merge_category and merge_payee: category or payee that remains

payee_id.description: for rename_payee and merge_payee: payee to change, from list_payees_and_tags

name: manage_card
description: Proposes a change to a credit card account's setup: add a plastic or virtual card, activate or deactivate one, set a new credit limit or a new billing cycle. Use it when the user changes card details. Do not use it for purchases or statements: handle_card_purchase and settle_statement do. The user confirms every change.

holder.description: for add_card: name printed on the card

virtual.description: for add_card: the card is virtual

active.description: for set_card_active: true activates, false deactivates

amount.description: for set_credit_limit: positive limit in the card's currency

effective_from.description: for set_credit_limit: first date of the limit; for set_billing_cycle: any date of the first statement month it applies to

closing_day.description: for set_billing_cycle: day of the month the statement closes

due_day.description: for set_billing_cycle: day of the month the statement is due

name: manage_imports
description: Proposes an action on imports and bank connections: sync a connection now, map a bank account of a connection to a ledger account or ignore it, resolve a record that needs review, delete a connection, or delete an integration without connections. Use it when the user asks to sync, map, review or remove a bank link. Do not use it to add credentials or a new connection: the user does that on the Links screen, and get_help explains it. The user confirms first.

connection_id.description: for sync, map_account and delete_connection: connection from get_imports

external_account_id.description: for map_account: bank account of the connection, from get_imports

account_id.description: for map_account: ledger account receiving the bank account's lines; absent with ignore

ignore.description: for map_account: stop importing this bank account

resolution.description: for resolve_record: match links it to transaction_id, create records a new transaction, discard drops it

transaction_id.description: for resolve_record with match: transaction from search_transactions

source.description: file format, or the aggregator for a sync

counts.description: lines by outcome; absent outcomes are zero

name: manage_instrument
description: Proposes defining a security for the whole instance, recording a manual price, or setting the terms of a fixed income instrument. Use it when the user needs a security that does not exist yet or a price that is missing. Do not use it to buy or sell: record_investment does. Instruments and prices are shared by every user of the instance; the user confirms first.

quote_currency.description: for define: currency the instrument is priced in

scale.description: for define: decimal places of a quantity

price.description: for record_price: decimal price of one unit in quote_currency

index_id.description: for set_terms: index identifier; absent for a fixed rate

percent_of_index_bp.description: for set_terms: percentage of the index in basis points, 11000 for 110%

spread_bp.description: for set_terms: annual spread in basis points

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56
decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

name: reconcile_account
description: Proposes a reconciliation step on an account: record the balance the institution reports at a date, resolve the open difference of a recorded balance, or unlock reconciled postings from a date. Use it when the user says what the bank shows or asks to reconcile. Do not use it to correct a single transaction: change_transaction does. The user confirms first.

date.description: for record_balance: date of the reported balance; for unlock: first date unlocked

amount.description: for record_balance: decimal balance the institution reports, negative for a debt

resolution.description: for resolve_difference: adjustment posts the difference to Adjustments, yield to Yield; transactions_added checks again after the user recorded the missing transactions

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

name: record_investment
description: Proposes an investment transaction in a brokerage: buy or sell a security for cash of the same brokerage at average cost, or record income paid on a security. Use it when the user reports a trade, a dividend or other investment income. Do not use it to define a new security: manage_instrument does. The user confirms first.

account_id.description: security account inside a brokerage, from list_accounts

cash_account_id.description: cash account of the same brokerage

quantity.description: for buy and sell: positive quantity of the security

unit_price.description: for buy and sell: decimal price of one unit in the cash account's currency

fees.description: for buy and sell: positive fees charged

taxes.description: for buy and sell: positive taxes charged

gross.description: for income: positive gross amount paid

withheld.description: for income: positive tax withheld at source

income_type.description: for income: type from get_portfolio with view income_types

category_id.description: for income: income category from list_accounts

name: record_transaction
description: Proposes a new transaction: money moves from one account or category to another. A purchase moves from a checking, cash or card account to an expense category; income moves from an income category to an asset account; a transfer moves between two own accounts. With installments on a card it records an installment purchase; with original_amount on a card it records a foreign purchase; with to_amount between two currencies it records an exchange. Use it when the user asks to record, add or log a transaction. Do not use it to change an existing transaction: change_transaction does. The user confirms the proposal before anything is recorded.

description.description: short description, such as the merchant or the purpose

amount.description: positive decimal amount in the currency of from_account_id, such as 125.90

from_account_id.description: account or category the money leaves: a checking, cash or card account for a purchase, an income category for income

to_account_id.description: account or category the money reaches: an expense category for a purchase, an asset account for income or a transfer; absent when splits is set
expense category or account receiving this part

amount.description: positive decimal amount of this part

splits.description: several destinations whose amounts add up to amount

installments.description: number of installments, 2 to 48, for a purchase on a credit card account

original_amount.description: for a foreign purchase on a card: positive amount charged in original_currency

original_currency.description: for a foreign purchase on a card: ISO 4217 code of the charged currency

exchange_rate.description: for a foreign purchase: decimal rate from original_currency to the card's currency, such as 5.4830

to_amount.description: for an exchange between accounts in two currencies: positive amount received in the currency of to_account_id

name: search_transactions
description: Searches the user's transactions, newest first, with their payee, tags and postings; each posting names its account or category. Use it to find transactions by text, account, category, tag, period or missing category, and to get the transaction_id other tools take. Do not use it for totals by category: get_category_totals adds them up. Filters combine; narrow them instead of reading many pages.

query.description: case-insensitive text found in the description, the payee name or a posting memo

account_id.description: keep transactions with a posting on this account or category; IDs come from list_accounts

uncategorized.description: keep only transactions still waiting for a category

limit.description: items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; absent for the first page

account_class.description: a posting on an income or expense account is the category of the transaction

amount.description: decimal amount in the instrument's scale, such as -1234.56

next_cursor.description: present when more transactions follow; pass it as cursor

name: settle_statement
description: Proposes an action on a credit card statement: pay it from an account, finance its unpaid amount in installments, confirm the amount the institution charges, or record or remove the institution's due date and total. Use it when the user pays a card bill or reports what the bank's statement says. Do not use it for one purchase: handle_card_purchase does. The user confirms first.

date.description: for pay and finance: date of the operation; today when absent

amount.description: for pay: amount paid; for confirm_amount_due and set_facts: the institution's total; positive, in the card's currency

from_account_id.description: for pay: account the payment leaves

installment_amount.description: for finance: positive amount of each installment

due_date.description: for set_facts: due date the institution states

closing_date.description: for set_facts: closing date the institution states

name: update_profile
description: Proposes changing the user's language or region, which set the language of the app and of these answers and the format of numbers and dates. Use it when the user asks to switch language or region. Do not use it for the base currency, which is fixed after the first transaction. The user confirms first.

language.description: ISO 639 language code, such as en or pt

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code, such as US or BR

name: void_transaction
description: Proposes voiding a transaction: it stops counting in balances and reports and stays in history with the reason. Use it when the user asks to delete, remove, cancel or void a transaction. Do not use it to change values: change_transaction does. The user confirms before the transaction is voided.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction, from search_transactions

reason.description: why the transaction is voided, kept in its history
